product_metadata.title: SEI Furniture Gear Hand Painted Art Wall Clock, Aged Metallic
features: Functional, decorative wall sculpture offers time and style with old-fashioned clock ticking sound
Rugged, stationary gears add style to any living room, bedroom or entryway above a console table
Aged metallic finish combines with Durable, all-metal construction for refined industrial style
Clock is made with metal and requires one AA battery for purchase
No assembly required item weighs 14 pounds and measures 40.5 inches wide x 1.25 inches deep x 33.25 inches high
description: This gear wall art is a great décor solution for the mechanically inclined or anyone who appreciates an industrial look and feel. The rugged design of oversized, stationary sprockets is constructed of hand painted metal. Its hand painted finish is done in aged metallic tones. This functional, decorative wall sculpture even features an old-fashioned clock ticking sound. Requires 1 AA battery (not included). Dimensions include: Overall: 40.5" W x 1.25" D x 33.25" H; Clock: 10.5" DIA. This one-of-a-kind item approximately weighs 14 pounds. Only quality materials and manufacturing will do. Product materials include: metal. Assembly: No assembly required. Made in China.
